name: ui-breadcrumb
description: Breadcrumb — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui breadcrumb pattern).

schema.name: ui-breadcrumb
schema.description: Breadcrumb — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui breadcrumb pattern).

emits.description: Event emitted when a non-current crumb is clicked, with payload `{ label, href, index }` — the trait handles it with `(navigate ?href)`. Without it, stack crumbs navigate directly.

events.name: @config.item event
events.description: Event emitted when a non-current crumb is clicked, with payload `{ label, href, index }` — the trait handles it with `(navigate ?href)`. Without it, stack crumbs navigate directly.

fromNavStack.label: From Nav Stack
fromNavStack.description: Render the current orbital's navigation stack (NavStackProvider) as the trail: one crumb per visited/declared level, last entry current. The stack is client-session state both execution paths maintain; outside a provider this renders nothing.

separator.label: Separator
separator.description: Separator icon (canonical kebab-case name or LucideIcon component)

items.label: Items
items.description: Breadcrumb items. Omit together with `fromNavStack` to render the orbital-scoped navigation stack instead of an authored trail.

itemEvent.label: Item Event
itemEvent.description: Event emitted when a non-current crumb is clicked, with payload `{ label, href, index }` — the trait handles it with `(navigate ?href)`. Without it, stack crumbs navigate directly.

maxItems.label: Max Items
maxItems.description: Maximum items to show (truncates with ellipsis)
